technology_name: METHOD FOR FORMULATION OF PHENOLIC-FORMALDEHYDE RESOLE RESINS WITH MULTISTAGE REACTORS
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Standard batch synthesis of resole resins is prone to unsafe runaway exothermic reactions, inconsistent polymer cross-linking densities, and elevated spatial footprint requirements.
description: A multi-stage reactor configuration framework comprising an initial feeding section, a continuous tubular loop reactor, and a final continuous stirred tank reactor (CSTR) designed to maintain high-quality phenolic-formaldehyde output under tight thermal constraints.
applications: Industrial polymer manufacturing, high-durability thermal insulation, automotive component laminates, aerospace composites, and structural adhesive formulations.
